SMART SENSING SYSTEM In this subsection, a detailed account of exploration on installing smart sensors system for the automated AM-CM process is included. As a part of this exploratory investigation, temperature sensors were obtained with a range of temperature detections and installed in the mold as shown in figure below. Upon printing the desired shape such as circular as shown here, the temperature sensors underneath the printed part change color. Finally, after the printing the temperature sensors can be removed to see the temperatures detected by the sensors and thus estimating the temperature profile within the mold during the additive manufacturing – compression overmolding process. TECHNOECONOMIC ANALYSIS In this study, a novel additive manufacturing – compression molding process was developed for the fabricated of seatback frame instead of using traditional metal-based seatback frame. The technoeconomic analysis of this novel manufacturing process for seatback frame is detailed in this section while a comparison to the original Ford’s seatback frame is included for reference. The overall cost of the original Ford’s seatback is $XX (redacted for Ford’s confidentiality). The designed seatback frame uses many of the original metal Ford’s seatback components. The cost for those components were readily available. The cost for the polymer composite parts, additive manufacturing, and compression overmolding processes along with joining between metal and composite parts through nuts and bolts were estimated. The table below lists the cost of each component in the seatback, material, manufacturing process, and estimated cost for seatback manufacturing through AM- CM process. The parts involving additive manufacturing such as LFT insert (polymer composite preform) and metal insert cost $24.43 and $51.18, respectively. In addition, the process of overmolding polymer composite onto a metal insert costs $99.37. The overall cost of fabricating seatback through AM-CM process is $191.50 in which AM, and CM processes constitutes $174.98. Due to the currently expensive AM and CM processes, the overall cost of the seatback through this novel process is expensive as compared to Ford’s seatback.
